race.comment: CIGAR MAN (1) was a touch disappointing last time out but go on the strong Toowoomba win two back. Can bounce right back from the inside alley. AYASAKI (12) got the chocolates at Grafton last start and has gotten better with each run this time in work. Capable of going back-to-back. WHATJEUDOIN' (5) next best in a wide open affair. FORTY TIMES (7) hasn't been far from the placegetters of late and should enjoy a nice run from this draw.
